en: A black and white photograph showing a large, symmetrical brick building with a central cupola, clock, and extensive windows, set back from a wide street or pathway. Surrounding the main building are smaller buildings and a tall chimney on the right. There is manicured landscaping with young trees and people walking or sitting on the grounds. The text 'Halmstad. Lasarettet.' is written in a decorative script at the bottom left corner.
